body.name: average-law adaptive fuzzy-prior handle
body.construction: Start from an optimizer \(v_\gamma^\star\) and cumulative discrepancies \(D_j(v_\gamma^\star)\); randomize bounded control-mean increments and coupled focal-arm perturbations, then seek an explicit sequential likelihood-ratio or Le Cam deficiency inequality for two TV-admissible priors after averaging over the assignment histories generated by each schedule.
